description: This file is a web UI page for configuring RIP routing settings, including interface selection, version, update interval, authentication, and neighbor IP addresses. It includes PHP code for server-side data retrieval, embedded JavaScript for dynamic form handling, and HTML for the form layout.

methods.name: initPopulate
methods.description: Populates form fields with current RIP configuration data.

methods.name: initEventHandler
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for authentication type selection to enable/disable input fields.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Sends updated RIP configuration data to the server via AJAX.
